extraction_notes: Supplied identity is preserved exactly as MPN NDC7002N(UMW) and manufacturer UMW(Youtai Semiconductor Co., Ltd.); the datasheet cover/body says UMW NDC7002N and the footer names UTD Semiconductor Co., Limited. No additional ordering alias is stated.

The cover says Dual 50V N-Channel MOSFET, while pages 2 through 7 headings say Dual 20V N-Channel MOSFET; the electrical table and BVDSS row specify 50 V. The 50 V electrical identity is retained in the title and breakdown specification.
The part is a dual N-channel MOSFET. Pin ordering evidence is G1/G2 on pins 1/3, S1/S2 on pins 2/5, and D1/D2 on pins 4/6; each die uses drain-gate-source ordering for model instances.

Datasheet electrical-characteristic heading states TA = 25 degC unless otherwise noted. The separate TJ = 125 degC threshold and RDS(ON) rows are retained only where the schema permits them; 25 degC rows are used for the primary threshold, capacitance, breakdown, and body-diode fields.
Threshold table semantics are MIN = 1.0 V, TYP = 1.9 V, MAX = 2.5 V at VDS = VGS and ID = 250 uA. The separate TJ = 125 degC threshold row is 0.8 V MIN, 1.5 V TYP, and 2.2 V MAX.

All published RDS(ON) rows are preserved: at VGS = 10 V and ID = 0.51 A, 1 ohm TYP and 2 ohm MAX at 25 degC; 1.7 ohm TYP and 3.5 ohm MAX at TJ = 125 degC; at VGS = 4.5 V and ID = 0.35 A, 1.6 ohm TYP and 4 ohm MAX at 25 degC.

IDSS is not representable in the strict MOSFET schema: the datasheet gives 1 uA MAX at VDS = 40 V, VGS = 0 V, TA = 25 degC, and 500 uA MAX at TJ = 125 degC. Gate leakage is also omitted from the schema.
Gate-charge evidence not representable in the strict schema: Qg = 1 nC TYP, Qgs = 0.19 nC TYP, and Qgd = 0.33 nC TYP at VDS = 25 V, ID = 0.51 A, VGS = 10 V. Figure 10 is a typical gate-charge plot.
VSD table semantics are TYP = 0.8 V and MAX = 1.2 V at VGS = 0 V and IS = 0.51 A; the schema stores the typical value and this note preserves the maximum.

Curve points are manual readings of plotted traces only, not values inferred from the electrical table. Figure 5 transfer curves include -55 degC, 25 degC, and 125 degC traces; only the 25 degC trace was digitized. Figure 1 output curves are typical traces with no temperature printed on the figure. Figure 9 capacitance traces are typical at VGS = 0 V and f = 1 MHz, with no temperature printed on the figure.
The datasheet provides no revision code beyond the printed Nov.2024 date. Supplied PDF SHA-256 is cde379e56da27b883536493dd20850a7012d81975a23f8ee2739671987fdea74.
